raw.setBoundary: Count babies/families mentioned as recently born/adopted within the “last few months” window relative to 2023/05/13, using the birth timing cues provided (e.g., “a few weeks ago,” “in March,” “in April,” “recently”).
raw.missingRisk: Some candidates only provide month-level timing (e.g., March/April) or ambiguous phrasing (“a few weeks ago,” “around the same time”), so downstream counting may require interpretation of what qualifies as “last few months.”

items.why: Provides the key “baby boy named Jasper a few weeks ago” fact (recent birth timing) for a friend (David).
Contains birth timing for multiple babies: Max (born in March), Charlotte (born around the same time as Max), and aunt’s twins Ava & Lily (born in April).
Adds another baby/adoption to include in the count: Sarah’s adopted daughter Aaliyah (timing described as recent in the earlier session facts).

Compares/collects additional recent-child facts in one place: Charlotte’s recent birth (“a few weeks after Rachel’s baby shower”), David/Jasper’s “a few weeks ago,” aunt’s twins Ava & Lily, and Sarah’s adopted child Aaliyah.
Reiterates the same “Jasper … a few weeks ago” and “Ava and Lily” facts in the get-together context, helpful as corroboration for counting Jasper/Ava/Lily as recent additions.
